description: This Java class defines a security filter for processing refresh token authentication requests in a Spring Security context, specifically for handling JWT refresh tokens in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: RefreshTokenProcessingFilter
classes.description: A Spring Security filter that processes JWT refresh token requests, validating the token and managing authentication success or failure.

methods.name: RefreshTokenProcessingFilter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the filter with URL and success/failure handlers.

methods.name: attemptAuthentication
methods.description: Handles the authentication attempt by parsing the refresh token from the request and delegating to the authentication manager.

methods.name: successfulAuthentication
methods.description: Handles actions upon successful authentication, invoking the success handler.

methods.name: unsuccessfulAuthentication
methods.description: Handles actions upon failed authentication, clearing security context and invoking the failure handler.
